context_requirements: Expression of FAAH and/or GPR119 in the cell line
Intact endocannabinoid/NAE signaling and lipid metabolism
Presence of endogenous FAAH substrates (anandamide, PEA, OEA) to accumulate upon inhibition
For GPR119-mediated effects, GPR119 receptor expression and Gs-coupled signaling
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Consistent upregulation of canonical FAAH/endocannabinoid target genes or GPR119-dependent transcriptional signature
Shared transcriptional response across multiple lines that is absent with vehicle and not explained by generic stress

evidence.supports: FAAH inhibition can affect melanoma growth, but effects are context-dependent and not shown to require transcriptional changes in the tested cell lines
FAAH inhibitor URB597 has neuroprotective effects in primary hippocampal neurons, a non-dividing, neuronal context not represented in the panel
FAAH inhibition reduces inflammatory mediators in a rat migraine model, suggesting in vivo rather than direct cancer cell line transcriptional effects
FAAH inhibition modulates cocaine-seeking behavior via CNS effects, not direct transcriptional responses in the tested cell lines
FAAH inhibitor URB597 affects renal cell carcinoma only in combination with a ferroptosis inducer, with no reported direct transcriptional signature in the tested lines
